description: This file defines the BuzzCommentDecorator class within the OrangeHRM system, providing a decorator pattern implementation for the BuzzComment entity. It offers methods for setting related entities, formatting dates, checking likes status, and modifying the number of likes for social media comments related to the Buzz feature.

classes.name: BuzzCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional functionalities and convenience methods for the BuzzComment entity, including setting related entities, formatting timestamps, and handling likes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a BuzzComment entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the BuzzComment based on employee number.

methods.name: setShareById
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare entity with the BuzzComment based on share ID.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the comment was created, formatted as Y-m-d.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the comment was created, formatted as H:i.

methods.name: isAuthEmployeeLiked
methods.description: Checks if the current authenticated user has liked the comment.

methods.name: increaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Increments the number of likes on the comment by one.

methods.name: decreaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Decrements the number of likes on the comment by one.
